PRIVACY

Privacy Policy

A simple explanation of how information submitted through the website is used.

Information We Collect

When using booking, spare-parts or contact forms, you may provide information such as your name, phone number, vehicle details, VIN, request details and preferred appointment date.

How We Use Information

Information is used to review your request, contact you, confirm appointments or parts availability, and follow up on the service related to your request.

Customer Service Messages on Social Platforms

When you contact Esotica Auto through WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger or Instagram, our customer-service system may receive your name or account identifier, the phone number available on that channel, message text, attachments, timestamps and delivery status. We use this information to respond, follow up and, when needed, connect the conversation to your customer or service record. Access is limited to authorised team members according to their account permissions.

Request Access, Correction or Deletion

You can submit a request about information or messages stored in the Esotica Auto system through the Contact Us page, including the account name, communication channel or phone number connected to the request, and what you want to access, correct or delete. We may request appropriate information to verify that the request belongs to the data owner. Do not include account passwords or sign-in codes.

Visit Analytics

The site uses a random identifier to count unique visitors and records general technical data such as device type, browser, operating system, language, approximate country and visited pages. Visitor analytics do not store names, phone numbers or IP addresses.

Campaign and Interaction Measurement

We record campaign source, landing page and interactions with booking, phone and WhatsApp links, and associate campaign source with successfully saved requests. Measurement records do not include names, phone numbers or form text, complete query strings or advertising identifiers. Measurement records older than 90 days are automatically removed during subsequent site activity. The browser retains visit attribution within a session that expires after 30 minutes of inactivity. Campaign and interaction measurement respects Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals.

Protection Against Abuse

To protect forms against automated messages and duplicate submissions, the website processes technical request data and temporarily keeps a non-reversible one-way fingerprint for no longer than 24 hours. The raw IP address is not stored by this protection system.

Payment Information

The current website does not request payment-card or banking information in its booking and contact forms.

External Links

The website may link to Google Maps, WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram. When opening those links, the external service's own terms and policies apply.

Questions About Your Information

You can contact us through the Contact Us page if you have a question about information you submitted through the website.

Policy Updates

This page may be updated when new website features or services are added, and the latest wording will appear here.
